title: City Data — Per-Client Overlay
description: Client-relative city fields that vary by which client serves the city. One file per (client, city) pair at data/cities/<client-slug>/<city-slug>.json. The scaffolder/renderer merges shared city data + the active client's overlay; a MISSING overlay for the build's client = SC-2 fail-loud (never fall back to another client's values, never silently use the shared file's defaults for these fields). Design authority: [WF-7] schemas. Implementation: [DA5] (scaffolder merge, SC-2 gate, auto-derivation, backfill).

distance_from_hq_phrase.description: HQ-relative distance description (e.g., 'Vienna is 10-15 minutes from our home base in Fairfax'). Derived from client geo.latitude/longitude + city coordinates — not copy-pasted. See [DA5] implementation for auto-derivation.

dispatch_time_phrase.description: Descriptive dispatch time from this client's HQ (e.g., '15-20 minute'). Derived, not copied.

dispatch_time_short.description: Abbreviated dispatch time (e.g., '15-20 min'). Derived, not copied.

no_trip_charge_cities.description: Cities where this client charges no trip fee. Client-specific — different clients have different no-charge zones.

other_areas_paragraph.description: Description of other service areas from this client's perspective.

distance_phrase.description: Service-slug-keyed distance overrides (e.g., emergency service may have different dispatch framing).

map_iframe_title.description: Google Maps iframe title attribute, parameterized per client (e.g., '<Client Name> service area in <City>'). Prevents the brand-leak bug where one client's map title appears on another client's page.
